record.question: Whoever, in contravention of any provision of NDPS Act, 1985 or any rule or order made or condition of licence granted thereunder, manufactures, possesses, sells, purchases, transports, imports interState, exports inter-State or uses any manufactured drug or any preparation containing any manufactured drug of small quantity, shall be punishable
options: with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both
with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both
with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both
record.explanation: Small-quantity manufactured drug attracts up to one year's rigorous imprisonment.
